position_beats.in_element: The position of the `Element` in the `Clip`
position_beats.in_section: The position of the `Section`, to be added to the positions of the respective `Element`s encapsulated by it

ontology.tied_to_previous: Notes can only be tied to the previous `Note`, so, they work as duration extension of the previous one
ontology.accidental: The accidental is a chromatic offset on the selected scale, relative to its tonic and NOT necessarilly to the Major scale
ontology.sharps: For diatonic modes `0-6`, positive values mean Sharps and negative values mean Flats

diatonic_mode_0.description: Sets the Diatonic scale or other 7 keys scales, where `0` means Major and `5` means minor
